name: M1_STOP_ATTRIBUTION_AND_ONE_COST_BREAKEVEN_V1
baseline: 123 entered unique symbol/side/signal/stop/target records from m1-trend-context-2026-11-15.json;71SL49TP3open; source31symbols run42879077420

diagnostic.false_break: M1 close back at/inside broken boundary in first5 completed held minutes before SL candle. Diagnostic only.
diagnostic.profit_before_stop: Net hypothetical exit at completed M1 closes strictly before stop candle, fees/spread/slippage same baseline. Thresholds positive,0.25R,0.5R,1R.
diagnostic.continued_after_stop: Original target touched in a strictly later M1 candle, before original signal+4h; not assume wider stop would be safe.

single_candidate.activation: At a completed held M1 close, net liquidation value after modeled fees and execution costs >=0.5 of original unit stop risk.
single_candidate.action: Move stop to smallest tick-rounded price covering modeled round-trip costs, effective only from next minute. Never widen stop; original TP unchanged.
single_candidate.ambiguity: Active stop takes precedence over target within same minute, including BE-target ambiguity. Adverse gaps exit at worse open, even if protection loses money.
single_candidate.entry: Unchanged actual baseline entry mid, time and position quantity; no new filter, no reentry, no risk increase.
single_candidate.horizon: Original common4h from confirmation; open positions remain censored and additionally mark-to-market at4h for fair comparison.

evaluation: Whole sample plus both existing calendar weeks; exploratory reused history, not out-of-sample. Report TP,originalSL,protected exits,open separately; netpositive count never relabeled as TP win rate.
screening_criteria: Promising only if total marked R and profit factor improve overall and markedR does not deteriorate in either week; otherwise do not promote. Independent new-period validation still required before deployment.
scope: Read-only audit branch, no production/Telegram/orders changes. No threshold search after result.
limitations: Synthetic fills/book,zero funding, frozencontracts, current gate retrospective.
Independently normalizedR across overlapping signals is not portfolioROI.
M1 no actual intraminute sequence; conservative stop-first.
